audience: Mac administrators who manage Apple devices, policies and alerts with Addigy

useCases.title: Find Macs that fail a security check
useCases.text: Find the devices with FileVault turned off, then check each one against its compliance benchmarks.

useCases.title: Triage unattended alerts
useCases.text: List the alerts that need action. Then acknowledge, mute or resolve the ones you have checked.

useCases.title: Review the policies and tickets of one device
useCases.text: Find a device, then list the policies assigned to it and its support tickets. Read the notes of a ticket.

useCases.title: Move devices between policies
useCases.text: List the policies, then assign devices to one policy or remove them from it. Removing can stop that policy's settings on those devices.

useCases.title: Audit console activity
useCases.text: Search the system events of a time range. List the console users with their roles to see who can make changes.
